measurement_limits: Stable 20/25-second frame pairs are observations, not universal readiness proof (#441).
Six distinct final RGB frame groups were visually inspected; remaining frames match those groups byte-for-byte.
Legacy launch records include unused page/zoom request fields. No navigation or zoom action was performed in this open-error probe; the actual positive control displays 1/78 at 48%.
The five unknown errors do not establish a server or credential cause. The eleven server-connection messages do not establish successful authentication or decryption if connectivity were supplied.
